title: M3 benchmark workload definition (IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md Phase 5)
description: Canonical workload for Baseline A (JS driver) vs Baseline B (Rust daemon). Both sides report the same results.json schema; scripts/bench.mjs --compare evaluates the kill rule.

workload.fixture: embedded data: URL (sign-in form); overridable via --fixture

metrics: cold first call (driver launch + first navigate, wall clock)
warm per-method p50/p95 (navigate, snapshot, click, fill, screenshot)
marginal RSS per session (slope of peak tree RSS across session counts)
total tree RSS (daemon process + descendants) sampled at 1 Hz

resultsSchema.warm: { byMethod: { <method>: { n, p50, p95, max } }, all: { n, p50, p95, max } }

killRule: If Rust shows <20% improvement in marginal memory per session AND <20% in warm-call p95 versus baseline A, do NOT ship the daemon as the default. Ship the JS driver instead.
notes: results.json is gitignored (bench/results/*.json): it is an artifact, not a claim.
bench/results/report.md is the checked-in decision memo generated from the latest run.
No 'faster/lighter' wording in any README before bench/results/report.md exists with both baselines.
